notes.title: Movies Tycoon: Dawn of Cinema
notes.content:
After months of hard work—and alongside our biggest update yet, version 2.1
[b]we’re excited to announce and launch our very first content expansion: [/b]

[h1]Dawn of Cinema[/h1]
This expansion was voted for and chosen by you, the community!
A huge thank you to everyone who participated—and if you haven’t already, we invite you to check out our public roadmap:

[url=https://portal.productboard.com/moviestycoon/1-movies-tycoon/tabs/3-future-content-expansions]https://portal.productboard.com/moviestycoon/1-movies-tycoon/tabs/3-future-content-expansions[/url]
Vote for your favorite upcoming content or suggest your own ideas!

[h1]About the Expansion[/h1]
Dawn of Cinema lets you play through the golden era of film history—[b]from the 1920s to the 1970s[/b]—and then continue into the future!
Expect new buildings, vintage props, and a period-appropriate environment to immerse yourself in.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716482/657a86b62b1d21432073143cdeef0687b1998a98.gif[/img]

[h3]Here’s what’s included:[/h3]
[list]
[*] 8 new set locations to shoot your movies in
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716482/f5d156f6db2f20eefb9e2fba49a95188a903dc33.gif[/img]
[*] Over 50 new clothing and hairstyle options for your characters
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716482/620c464c3681fead3bd3221469f915c5f5447179.gif[/img]
[*] Era-specific camera technologies that evolve over time:
[list]
[*] Start with silent, black-and-white cameras using written dialogue
[*] Transition to black-and-white film with sound
[*] Move into early color film
[*] And finally, unlock the modern camera system
[/list]
[/list]All of these camera options are fully available in the movie editor, so you can take full creative control and style your films with historical accuracy.

We hope you enjoy this new content as much as we enjoyed creating it! We’re continuing to work on both free and paid content updates, so stay tuned, and [b]thank you for your ongoing support![/b]

notes.title: Movies Tycoon v2.1.0 - Biggest update yet! More FPS, New AI features and Content
notes.content:
[b]After a few months of hard work, we’re excited to bring you our biggest update yet! This massive release has something interesting for everyone.[/b]

Here’s a breakdown of all the new fixes, improvements, and content:

[h2]Performance Improvements[/h2]
In this update, we’ve significantly boosted game performance by reducing system load across the board.
Depending on your hardware and in-game content, you can expect anywhere from a 50% to 100% increase in FPS. This is especially noticeable on low and mid-range devices, where improvements reach up to 100%. High-end systems still see a solid 50% boost. We’ve also reduced RAM and VRAM usage by around 1.5GB each.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716482/ccfe5d3f6fe92df3aa2b86f2829015ef2a69faae.gif[/img]
In case you were wondering how we did that:
[list]
[*] Rebuilt our character customization system from scratch, making it more efficient than the engine’s solution.
[*] Reduced the number of animations for off-screen characters.
[*] Optimized gameplay simulations.
[*] Tweaked engine settings for better performance specific to our project.
[/list]
We’re quite happy with overall FPS performance now, [i]though we’re still working on fixing some remaining stuttering issues in the coming weeks.[/i]

[h2]Improved Character Visuals[/h2]
While reworking the character system, we also upgraded their visuals! Surface and contour shading is now far more accurate and realistic.
Be sure to take advantage of the extended slider ranges by holding the CTRL key. Go wild with it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716482/3cb5937a50daf3b5ae27a129458878e55f7d21ca.gif[/img]

[h3]New Thumbnails[/h3]
We’ve redesigned the character thumbnail panel for improved visuals and performance. It now supports continuous animation when interacted with.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716482/0c693190c59f0de948d28946a864d9f2ecc011a3.gif[/img]

[h2]In-Studio Custom Movies[/h2]
We’ve reintegrated the movie editor into the base tycoon game!
Creating your own movies during regular gameplay is now easier than ever. Every scriptwriter building now has a button that launches the movie editor with your game movie preloaded. Once you’re done, just return to the tycoon game and continue playing with your custom film.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716482/d7aaeae81961a6fdcdea04cdafdc3e8504969d09.gif[/img]

[h2]New AI Feature![/h2]
To make movie creation even easier, we’ve added an AI panel to the movie editor.
You can now have the AI generate a movie for you! Just pick the genre, theme, and size, then describe your idea—and the AI will create a movie in seconds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716482/f00cda1c9f2780b8d0c87ac81edba13a147a348e.gif[/img]

[i]Personally, I’ve spent way too much time reading through hilarious AI-generated mashups of movies, series, and video games—even before we made this game.
We’ll be expanding the AI features in this panel over time, so stay tuned![/i]

[h2]New DLC![/h2]
The community voted—and we listened!
Tomorrow we are releasing the most popular request for our first content expansion: Dawn of Cinema.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3613010/Movies_Tycoon_Dawn_of_Cinema/

We’ll have a separate post with full details, so be sure to check it out!
[url=https://portal.productboard.com/moviestycoon/1-movies-tycoon/tabs/3-future-content-expansions]
Also, don’t forget to visit our public roadmap where you can vote on the next content expansion![/url]

[h2]What’s Next? Community Sharing![/h2]
While we packed a lot into this update, one major feature had to be postponed for version 2.2: [b]Community Content Sharing.[/b]
Originally, we planned to integrate with Steam Workshop, but instead, we’ve decided to build a native in-game sharing platform that will work across all platforms—not just Steam.

[b]Coming soon in the 2.2 update, you’ll be able to share your custom characters and movies with friends and the wider community![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716482/4e53b420dbee0d47a488f85e5b077efdcd6e4bac.png[/img]

And that’s not all...

To sweeten the deal, after launching the community content update, [b]we’ll be hosting monthly movie-making competitions![/b] You’ll be able to submit and rate films, and at the end of each month, we’ll pick the top-rated entries and award prizes. Details coming soon!

There are a bunch of smaller improvements we didn’t mention here, but we’ve covered the most important stuff.

[b]As always, thank you all for your continued support and feedback!
If you’d like us to keep building on this game, please consider leaving a review—and we’ll be back with another big update soon!
[/b]

Another small update for you all :)

We've reworked the production priority game mechanic to better hit at ratios of each priority. There is now a predefined easy solution to the puzzle and all there is to do is to swap the priorities.

Next update will also add more hints as to which themes influence priorities.

We've also added a new board to each of the production offices that shows your previous movie setups to compare more easily.

Thank you all for your feedback, 
Merry Christmas and happy holidays!

notes.title: Movies Tycoon 2.0 released!
notes.content:
[b]Movies Tycoon has just released it's biggest update yet! [/b]
We'd like to thank you all for your support through our early access journey. We've learned a lot and worked a lot to push this game and the whole movie game concept forward! But obviously we are not done just yet!

[url=https://i.imgur.com/1l6UTSh.gif][img]https://i.imgur.com/1l6UTSh.gif[/img][/url]

Apart from bug hunting and testing at scale (again, thank you all for your reports), early acces has been important to us to figure out where should our priorities be for this game. We've received enough feedback to give help us find the right priorities.

Moving on, Movies Tycoon will receive weekly free updates with focus on bugfixing, performance optimizations and movie/animation improvements. Now during launch, probably even more frequent than that. Afterwards we'll be working on expanding all parts of the game, starting off with a content expansion into the 1920s and the early dawn of cinema. This upcoming update will offer free content for the base game, improving the building and object placement mechanics, while offering paid content to those who want it. We'll talk about this new content a bit later on.

Please check out our public roadmap here: 
[url=https://portal.productboard.com/moviestycoon/1-movies-tycoon]https://portal.productboard.com/moviestycoon/1-movies-tycoon[/url]

There you can have a look at our concluded Early Access journey and what's coming next.
[b]But what's most important, you can vote or suggest where should we take the game next! [/b]We have a few ideas listed already. Please let us know what you think or suggest your own idea!

For now, let's enjoy the game and the very long and juicy patch notes!

[b]New Tycoon Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] more in-game data and statistics
[*] all sorts of UI improvements
[*] improvements to tutorials
[*] economy and other values rebalanced
[*] new right side control panel
[*] building animation sequence improved
[*] achievements

[*] new UI window for building information

[*] Cars! in game and around your studio
[*] characters now trample grass

[*] movies being filmed can now be heard
[*] improved readability of all text
[/list]


[b]New Character Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] character clothing themes
[*] new clothing and costumes
[*] costumes clip eyes and mouth
[*] characters have adjustable height
[*] new hair and beards
[*] hair and teeth no longer glow at night
[/list]

[b]New Movies Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] over 700 new movies
[*] movies now match themes
[*] more movie props
[*] movies now respect themes
[*] movies have better camera controls
[*] movies have more filming options

[*] all new AI voices
[*] movie subtitles
[*] movies utilize props and costumes
[/list]

[b]Other:[/b]
[list]

[*] portugal translation
[*] Steam cloud saves
[*] new main menu
[*] steam deck support
[*] a looot of bugfixes
[/list]

notes.title: Movies Tycoon 2.0 coming up!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

You may have noticed a lack of recent updates, but that’s because we’ve been hard at work on something big. Rather than releasing these improvements individually, we’ve decided to combine them into a major 2.0 update!

[h2]Every aspect of the game is getting a major update![/h2]


[h3]Expanded character customization[/h3]
More clothing, hairstyles, beards, and costumes! Outfits are now themed, making it easier to pick the right look for in-game, studio use, and movie production.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/L86GwGu.gif[/img]

[h3]Improved animations and studio life[/h3]
Character animations and daily activities in your studio have been enhanced for a more immersive experience.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/hIIudg0.gif[/img]

[h3]Tycoon gameplay upgrades[/h3]
New features like detailed studio statistics and the ability to make your own movies right in your studio! Tutorials have also been updated to make things smoother.

[h3]Movie-making improvements[/h3]
Dynamic previews, more filming locations on previous sets, additional props, animations, and a host of new sets! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ueON0kG.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/yHU52Xj.gif[/img]

You’ll be able to create even more epic productions.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/h7cr4Dv.gif[/img]

All NEW natural sounding dynamic voices for your movie stars!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/dxs1gjN.gif[/img]
What’s that? GIFs don’t have sound? I guess we’ll have to wait a bit longer for the real deal! ;)


As you can see, this update delivers everything from our original roadmap—and more! [b]We’re incredibly grateful for your feedback and testing during early access[/b]. The game has come a long way, and we’re nearing the finish line. After some final internal (and public) testing, [b]we’ll be releasing the full version of Movies Tycoon soon![/b]

Thank you again for your incredible support. We can’t wait to share the full game with you in just a few weeks. [b]Stay tuned for more exciting updates—including a brand new public roadmap after the full release![/b]

notes.title: The future of Movies Tycoon - Early Access Timeline
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

[b]We'd like to thank you all for your feedback during Early Access! [/b]We've been closely monitoring all of it, and we've created a timeline explaining how and when we are going to implement each suggestion. It's publicly visible here:

[url=https://portal.productboard.com/moviestycoon/1-movies-tycoon]https://portal.productboard.com/moviestycoon/1-movies-tycoon[/url]

We've been hard at work fixing every significant bug encountered, and the list of bugs is getting shorter. [b]Now, we can start working on improving the game in general. [/b]We have considered every single post and comment on Steam and Discord and extracted a list of things we will be implementing in August and September. Not every small item made it to the list, but that doesn't mean they won't be addressed; they just weren't significant enough to write about.

There are also a few topics that have been suggested, and we want more feedback on them before we decide whether we will implement them or not. You can vote on each topic to let us know if they are important to you.

Last but not least - the full release. Our Early Access will be a short one. Once all of these items are completed and released, we believe we will have an improved, stable, and polished release candidate, and we'll announce the full release.

After the full launch, there are several areas where we could expand the game with future content. We have a few candidates listed on the timeline, and [b]we'd love to know if any of them interest you, or if you have other suggestions.[/b]

[b]Again, we'd like to thank you all for your support during our Early Access. It means the world to us, and we wouldn't be able to do this without you. [/b]We know we are not 100% there yet, but we are close and getting closer with every update.

Thank you for sticking with us while we figure things out. As I've mentioned before, we've unfortunately missed our release date. notes.title: Movies Tycoon Early Access coming soon!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

[b]We'd like to thank you all for providing your feedback on our latest demo during the Steam Next Fest! [/b]We've learned a lot and are working hard to release the best game possible. There is much more content coming up in the full game than what we've offered in the demo, and we can't wait to share it with you. Most notably, we're looking forward to seeing what you all create with it!

Regarding the feedback on our game, we're really glad to see you all satisfied with the main pillars of our game. However, we'd also like to express our appreciation for the feedback about the many little quirks and issues that we haven't yet addressed (e.g., some UI elements, sound/visual effects, animations). The scope of the game and the concept, in general, is almost limitless, while our development capacity really isn't. We see all the imperfections as well, and we're working on them now. We will continue working on them during early access and will keep improving things after release as well.

Notably, we are also starting to receive feedback of opposing preferences. Some people like the busy management aspect of handling everything around the studio, while others call for more automation. Some want us to focus more on the creative aspects of the game, while others prefer the simulation and the numbers. Some say they only care about either the custom movie editor or the tycoon game. It's probably impossible to satisfy everyone, but we sure as heck will try.

[b]We've decided to change our release from a regular one to early access.[/b] During early access, we want to achieve the following:

[list]
[*] Collect feedback on the simulation part of the game
[*] Collect feedback on the custom character and movie-making part of the game
[*] Improve and fix all the little quirks and issues people find
[*] See which part of the game is more enticing to players and where they like to spend most of their time
[/list]
If either the simulation or the creativity part of the game is heavily preferred by the players, we'll continue development on that part. If both are important to the players and one has no meaning without the other, we'll update the game mechanics to better reflect that and intertwine the two worlds. This will also influence where we want to take our game next with feature expansions.

[b]For now, we continue working hard on the full game coming on the 25th. The early access release is not reducing our scope or content in any way and will not last for too long. It's the full game coming out. We just want our community to help us shape it in their preferred way, and we want to make it clear that we are still working on and improving our game until we are absolutely satisfied with it.[/b]

We'll see you all very soon! :)

notes.title: Let’s dive headfirst into what Movies Tycoon is
notes.content:
First of all, what is this game? [b]It’s a tycoon game. [/b]Just like any other, the main goal is to run and manage a successful business. We love the theme of movies and filmmaking, and we think this particular corner of the tycoon genre is missing something. We can all sense what it is. We can all point out what needs to be done, and we are now working on that monumental task. However, [b]we have really big shoes to fill[/b], and although we are working very hard, we have to work with the options we have. Our team is small, and our resources are finite, so we choose our battles very carefully to create the best game we can.

[b]Over the next couple of weeks and months, we will be sharing more about each part of our game [/b]through posts and videos. We will talk in detail about our game mechanics, character dynamics, and all sorts of other movie-making hijinks. [b]So make sure to stick around and join our community on Steam, Discord, or Reddit so you don’t miss anything.[/b]

Now, let's talk gameplay. We will reveal actual gameplay in a dedicated video soon. We just have to polish a few things first. Although we are not done visually, you can get a feel for the game from the trailer. There is nothing there that isn’t a part of the game (animations in the trailer just mimic player input). Even the camera movement, going from inside a virtual scene to cast and crew members at work, to a high-level building and management view, is exactly how we want the player to engage with a film studio.

[b]The game is set to start in the 1970s and progresses all the way into the current 2020s.[/b] We chose this time period because chances are most of your all-time favorite movies will be in this range. As the game and time progress, so does the challenge of making a movie. The bar keeps getting higher, and you have to expand and keep up with the competition, both technologically and in terms of process complexity. A proper movie production nowadays is truly mind-blowing, and by mimicking most of the actual steps of making a movie, we aim to strike the perfect [b]balance between depth and entertainment.
[/b]
You start with a small loan, a piece of land, and a dream to make the best movies of all time. Starting with budget options, you might find yourself hard-pressed for talent, so you need other incentives to lure talent. Building the studio in such a way that everyone has all the amenities they need is a great way to keep the actors, directors, writers, and other staff happy to be working with you.

Speaking of which, let's talk about characters. We feel it’s very important for any movie to have high control over your casting and actors. That’s why [b]we’ve created a very extensive character creator[/b] that gives you the option to create and sculpt your actors precisely to your liking. There are still a few customization options left that we want to implement, but even now, we are at over 200 customization sliders that can be continuously moved or shaped. Ranging from the angle of the outer part of an eyebrow to the whole body shape and size. Although we are not really aiming for photorealism, the [b]characters can be made anywhere from crazy cartoonish to somewhat realistic[/b]. What is really important, though, is that each character designed can be encoded into just a few letters and loaded up by anyone. We want people to get creative with this tool and create all sorts of characters that can be [b]easily shared between players[/b]. Of course, all characters have emotions; they can look at things, interact with things, and they can also talk.

[b]We will soon make this character creator publicly available as a demo, so you can play around with the characters and create your actors beforehand.[/b]

One last chapter to discuss is custom movies. Yes, we also want players to be able to create their own movies. And although the technology has evolved in some fronts, creating a great movie editor is still a ridiculously complex task that has no scope or limits. Our primary focus is on making a great game first, and although we want to have a powerful movie editor as well, the only way to handle this task is in steps. We will start small and expand the capabilities over time.
[b]
We are in it for the long haul.
[/b]
This game would really benefit from a never-ending stream of content, so we want to continue working on this game for years to come, expanding each area of the game, ultimately creating both a great game and a great creative outlet.

[b]We hope you will join us on this journey. Thank you for reading.[/b]
